issues.description: Field 'books' of class Bookstore: in the solution (SOLUTION_REPOSITORY: Sources/BookstoreLib/Bookstore.swift lines 11-11) it is declared as a private stored property ('private let books: [Book]'). However, Client.main in the solution (SOLUTION_REPOSITORY: Sources/BookstoreLib/Client.swift lines 10-10) accesses 'bookstore.books', and the problem statement (PROBLEM_STATEMENT: problem_statement.md lines 8-12) defines that Bookstore holds an array named 'books' which callers/tests should be able to iterate. Declaring the stored property private prevents access from Client and from tests in other files in the module and will cause a compilation error or block the tests from inspecting the bookstore contents.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the stored books property accessible to other files in the module while preserving immutability. For example, remove the 'private' modifier so the declaration is 'let books: [Book]' (internal visibility), or provide an internal/public read-only accessor. Avoid making it mutable; keep it a 'let' or expose only a read-only computed property.
